codeReview.summary: Reviewed the fix feature entry, the prior blocking review, the round-one synthesis, the worker transcript skeleton, the worker handoff, the landed source, and commit `1c2e90e90f4aab67160a540cd877eb1558c9fe7e`. The fix addresses the original blocker: `resolveDefaultOrgTeamsStore` now returns explicit durable-vs-dev-only mode metadata, durable initialization failures throw instead of silently falling back to memory, and `services/auth-broker/src/index.ts` emits startup output that reports the selected mode. Updated tests cover the no-`DATABASE_URL` path, the durable path, and the fail-closed durable-init path, so the prior silent in-memory fallback is no longer present in the shipped default startup path.
